mootSayLines.text: Word reaches you, days late: Donizar stands accused over what happened to Oliver. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Oliver has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Donizar answers for what happened to Oliver.
🔴 LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
Oliver calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.
They're named, every one: Elena Osei, Hana Hassan, Andre Cohen. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Elena nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.

mootSayTvExcluded.text: 📺 CONTEST: The Moot. Televised trial. Defend yourself against accusations (true or not). The audience is the jury.
📺 The Moot. Televised trial. Defend yourself against accusations (true or not). The audience is the jury.
📺 ● LIVE — The Moot. Giulia is on television.

📺 The Moot. Giulia has been taken.

Televised trial. The accusations are read out — true or not, the cameras don't care. The audience is the jury.

Giulia stands at the mic alone. Seventeen systems are watching.

📺 The Moot — the defense. Giulia is talking, and the jury-feed shows the galaxy's verdict ticking up and down with every sentence.

One wrong word and it tanks. One right word and it soars. Truth is just another special effect here.

📺 The Moot — closing. The accusations hang in the air like smoke.

The jury votes. Guilty or not, the verdict is televised, and the village will have to live next to whatever the galaxy decides.
📺 The Moot — GIULIA WINS. The crowd is a weather system.
